user.title: Atmoce Gateway — Connection
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your Atmoce Gateway (MC100 / MG100).

data_description.slave: Only change this if your gateway was configured with a non-default Slave ID. Leave it at 1 if unsure.

battery.title: Batteries
battery.description: How many Atmoce MS-7K-U batteries are installed? Atmoce ships a single 7 kWh unit, so the count is all that is needed to work out the usable capacity and the power limits. An MS-14K-U is two of these units.

data_description.battery_count: Each unit adds 7 kWh, 3.75 kW of charge power and 4.5 kW of discharge power.
data_description.manual_specs: Tick this for different hardware, or if your inverter caps the total power below the sum of the units.

cloud.title: atmocecloud.com account (optional)
cloud.description:
Enter **your normal atmocecloud.com login**, the same one you use in the ATMOZEN app.

It drives the **battery limits**: end-of-charge SOC, end-of-discharge SOC and backup reserve. Those three settings do not exist over Modbus, so this is the only way to change them from Home Assistant.

Leave it blank and everything else still works, but those three controls will show as unavailable.

data_description.cloud_web_email: The email you sign in with at atmocecloud.com or in the ATMOZEN app.
data_description.cloud_web_password: The password for that same account. It is stored in your Home Assistant and never appears in diagnostics.

fallback.title: Cloud monitoring fallback (advanced)
fallback.description:
**Almost nobody needs this step — just press Submit.**

It covers one rare case: the gateway stops answering over Modbus on your local network. If that happens and you enable this, the integration keeps reading data from the Atmoce Open API for the duration of the outage. It is backup monitoring only; it adds no controls.

It needs `app_key` and `app_secret`, which **do not ship with your hardware and cannot be generated from any website**. Per the Open API manual (§3.1.2) the installer requests them by email from Atmoce support, giving the installer name, system name and system overview, and accepting the API licence. They are meant for installers and integrators managing several sites.

If you do not have them, leave the toggle off and the fields empty.

data_description.cloud_enabled: Only turn this on if Atmoce support has given you an app_key and app_secret; without them the form will not let you continue.
data_description.cloud_app_key: Issued by Atmoce support. It is not your password and cannot be generated from the portal.
data_description.modbus_retry_count: How many consecutive Modbus failures before falling back to the Cloud.

reconfigure.title: Battery stack
reconfigure.description:
Use this after adding or removing a battery. Capacity and power limits are set once at setup and feed the autonomy sensor and the forced-power sliders, so they need restating when the stack changes.

Nothing else is touched: your gateway, credentials and entity history all stay as they are.

data_description.battery_count: Each MS-7K-U unit adds 7 kWh, 3.75 kW of charge power and 4.5 kW of discharge power. An MS-14K-U counts as two units.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Atmoce gateway. Check the IP address and that Modbus TCP is enabled.
error.cloud_credentials_required: Both app_key and app_secret are required when Cloud fallback is enabled.

init.title: Atmoce options
init.description:
Two independent features, with separate credentials.

**Battery limits** (charge/discharge/reserve): just your atmocecloud.com login, email and password.

**Monitoring fallback**: Open API `app_key` and `app_secret`, requested from Atmoce support — they do not ship with the hardware. If you do not have them, leave those fields empty and the toggle off.

data_description.modbus_retry_count: How many consecutive Modbus failures before falling back to the Cloud.
data_description.cloud_enabled: Only turn this on if you have an app_key and app_secret.
data_description.cloud_app_key: Requested from Atmoce support. Leave empty if you do not have one.
data_description.cloud_app_secret: Issued together with the app_key. Leave empty if you do not have one.
data_description.cloud_web_email: The email you sign in with at atmocecloud.com or in the ATMOZEN app.
data_description.cloud_web_password: The password for that same account. It comes pre-filled with the stored one: clearing it also clears it from the configuration.

error.cloud_credentials_required: Both app_key and app_secret are required when Cloud fallback is enabled.
